description: This file declares the MediaPipelineService class, which implements the IMediaPipelineService interface. It manages media pipeline sessions, including creation, destruction, loading media, attaching sources, controlling playback, and querying capabilities. The class interacts with various services and factories related to media processing within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: MediaPipelineService
classes.description: Implements the IMediaPipelineService interface, managing media pipeline sessions, media sources, playback controls, and capabilities within the Rialto server environment.

methods.name: MediaPipelineService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the media pipeline service with references to playback, factory, capabilities, and decryption services.

methods.name: ~MediaPipelineService
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new media pipeline session with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroySession
methods.description: Destroys an existing media pipeline session.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media into a session with specified type, MIME type, and URL.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to a session.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from a session.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached for a session.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback for a session.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback for a session.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback for a session.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for a session.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position for a session.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window dimensions for a session.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Indicates whether data is available for a session.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a frame for a session.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for a session.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume for a session.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes audio for a session.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Checks if audio is muted for a session.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type is supported.

methods.name: clearMediaPipelines
methods.description: Clears all active media pipelines.
